name: Helium 10
description: Research Amazon keywords and products, track rankings, analyse listings and check profits and ad performance from Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot through Helium 10's official MCP server.
instructions:
This connector bridges **Helium 10 MCP**, Helium 10's official remote MCP server at `https://mcp.helium10.com/mcp`. Helium 10's own server provides the tools: keyword research (Magnet, Cerebro reverse ASIN), product research (Black Box), Brand Analytics and search query performance, Keyword Tracker rank history, listing analysis and the Listing Builder, Profits (Amazon and Walmart P&L, COGS and indirect costs), inventory and sales velocity, account health and alerts, Buy Box, reviews, TikTok Shop and Amazon influencer research, Market Tracker 360 and Helium 10 Ads (query, campaign management, bid rules, change log). Amazon marketplaces: US, UK, DE, JP, CA, AU, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, SE and MX; Walmart and TikTok Shop: US. AnythingMCP puts the tools behind your MCP endpoint with OAuth for Claude and ChatGPT, per-tool roles, the audit log and response mapping, next to your other systems.

**The tools come from the server.** Helium 10 signs you in before it lists anything, so the catalog's list is installed first; once you authorize, AnythingMCP asks Helium 10 MCP for its tools and takes their current descriptions and schemas. The server only lists the tools your plan and add-ons entitle you to (Market Tracker 360, Ads, Walmart). Click **Discover tools** on the connector to pick up new ones.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**:
1. Install the connector. There is nothing to paste: you do not need a Helium 10 API token (`h10_mcp_...`).
2. On the connector page click **Authorize with Provider**. AnythingMCP reads Helium 10's OAuth metadata, registers itself as a client (dynamic client registration) and sends you to the Helium 10 sign-in.
3. Sign in, choose the account (sub-users choose the primary account they were granted) and click **Authorize**. Back in AnythingMCP the tools are listed again from the server.

**Whose access it is**: the person who authorizes is the Helium 10 user for every caller of this connector, with that user's plan, seller accounts and permissions. Sub-users need the **MCP** permission from the primary account owner (Access Management > User Accounts). After a long period without use Helium 10 asks you to sign in again: click **Authorize with Provider** once more. Connections are listed and revoked in Helium 10 under **Settings > MCP > Authorized AI Clients Management**.

**Costs**: every tool call (and every extra page) uses one of the 1,000 MCP calls a month included with Diamond; the quota is shared with sub-users, and top-ups are 500 calls for $50. `helium10_get_mcp_usage_info` shows what is left. Ask for specific ASINs, marketplaces and date ranges instead of broad sweeps.

**Safety**: everything that changes Amazon or your ads installs switched off: `helium10_sync_listing_to_amazon` (overwrites the live listing), `helium10_execute_ads_campaign_mgmt_actions` (pauses, creates campaigns, changes bids and budgets) and `helium10_manage_ads_rule` (bid automation), plus every delete (COGS, indirect costs, tracked keywords and products, keyword notes). Research, reporting, generating listing drafts and keeping tracker tags and notes stay on. Ads tools need the Ads profile in Managed mode in Helium 10, which carries a 2% fee on ad spend.

**Working with it**: start with `helium10_get_my_amazon_seller_accounts` or `helium10_list_my_products` when you have no ASIN, then `helium10_get_keywords_by_asin`, `helium10_search_products` or the P&L tools. Always pass ASINs (10 characters) and the marketplace (default US). Ads Query runs in five steps, platforms, list, schema, materials, then `helium10_execute_ads_query`. A 401 after it worked means the sign-in expired: authorize again. `FEATURE.ADS_ACCESS_DISABLED` means the Ads profile is not in Managed mode; an empty tool list or missing tools means the plan or add-on does not include them.
prerequisites:
- A Helium 10 Diamond plan or higher (Elite included); MCP comes with 1,000 tool calls a month, and Market Tracker 360, Ads and Walmart tools need those features on the account.
- After saving, you click Authorize with Provider and sign in with Helium 10; whoever signs in is the Helium 10 user for everyone who uses this connector.
- A sub-user needs the MCP permission from the primary account owner in Access Management.

tools.name: helium10_list_amazon_influencers_in_folder
tools.description: Get all Amazon influencers saved in one Influencer Finder folder, with their key metrics.

folder_id.description: ID of the folder, from list_amazon_influencer_folders.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (each extra page counts as one API call).

tools.name: helium10_add_amazon_influencers_to_folder
tools.description: Add Amazon influencers to an Influencer Finder folder for organization. Several influencers can be added in one call.

tools.name: helium10_list_user_markets
tools.description: List the Market Tracker 360 (MT360) markets of your account. Only available with the MT360 add-on.

tools.name: helium10_get_market_overall
tools.description: Get the overall Market Tracker 360 historical series for one MT360 market (optionally compared): market size, growth trends and changes in the competitive landscape.

end_date.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (dates after today are clamped to today).

tools.name: helium10_get_market_statistics
tools.description: Get headline Market Performance statistics for one MT360 market: your share, market share by category, competitive metrics and performance indicators.

end_date.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (dates after today are clamped to today).

tools.name: helium10_get_market_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the ranked leaderboard of one MT360 market: top categories, brands or sellers by the chosen metric.

dimension.description: What to rank: categories, brands or sellers.

metric.description: Metric to rank by, e.g. revenue or units.

tools.name: helium10_get_market_products
tools.description: Get paginated current product rows for one MT360 market: ASIN attributes, BSR, pricing, reviews and sales data.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (each extra page counts as one API call).
